changeSet.author: modoria
changeSet.comment: Merge CUSTOMER role into CLIENT safely, even if CLIENT already exists.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO roles(name) SELECT 'CLIENT' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles WHERE name = 'CUSTOMER') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles WHERE name = 'CLIENT');

UPDATE user_roles SET role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = 'CLIENT') WHERE role_id = (SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = 'CUSTOMER') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles WHERE name = 'CLIENT') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles WHERE name = 'CUSTOMER');
